notes: This contract pins the official C++ surfaces used by the bounded changed-lookahead directed-interaction re-enable slice. A producer queues one target-qualified timestamped Send Directed Interaction while regulating with lookahead one, disables regulation, re-enables it with lookahead three, verifies Query Lookahead, and advances to establish the new GALT boundary before the constrained recipient's Receive Directed Interaction and Time Advance Grant callbacks. The queued message, target, callback metadata, and retraction classification are preserved across the role transition. This is development-profile evidence only; it does not claim directed DDM, remote transport, save/restore, package/JUnit/protected-review evidence, validation, interoperability, or conformance.
